Upon successful transmission of a NM message in Network

⌋
(RS_Nm_00044)
7.4.1.1 Repeat Message State
The Repeat Message State ensures, that any transition from Bus-Sleep or Prepare
Bus-Sleep to the Network Mode becomes visible for the other nodes on the network.
Additionally, it ensures that any node stays active for a minimum amount of time.
